# Acquire and integrate another business

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When the company evaluates purchasing another company, product line or business assets. An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Outcomes

- An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Define the acquisition thesis and capacity

agent-runnable


State the customer, product or capability sought, available funding and acceptable operating risk. Model the standalone and integrated cases and identify what must be true for the purchase to create value.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve diligence scope and transaction authority

human · human approval required


Leadership and advisers verify the counterparty, confidentiality, structure and conflicts. Approve a bounded diligence budget and access plan without committing to buy before the required evidence is available.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Conduct a controlled diligence and integration assessment

agent-runnable


Reconcile financial, customer, employee, IP, security, product and contract evidence. Record unsupported claims, liabilities and integration dependencies with owners and decision impact.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve terms, conditions and integration governance

human · human approval required


The authorized decision makers review price, financing, conditions, warranties and transition obligations with counsel. Assign a responsible integration lead and protect critical customer and workforce continuity.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Complete closing through the reviewed process

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized advisers and operators verify approvals, settlement instructions and closing conditions. Retain transaction evidence before changing ownership records or taking control of acquired systems.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Execute and measure the approved integration plan

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Reconcile acquired assets and obligations, phase access and data migrations safely and track customer and employee commitments. Review actual outcomes against the thesis and maintain owners for unresolved liabilities.

- Verify: An authorized acquisition decision and controlled integration with reconciled assets, people and obligations.
- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
